text: [issue by KRO5I5] ### Steps to Reproduce the Crash I have updated JEI to its latest version of Fabric 1.21.1 and I have found out with the help of First Person Model's developer in mod support on discord. That it would crash my game when I access the First Person Model config on Mod Menu. I have been using JEI version 19.42.0.389 which works properly. p.s. the creator of fpm said its a oneline fix. ### Mod Pack URL (Optional) _No response_ ### Mod Pack Version (Optional) 1.21.1 ### Extra Notes (Optional) _No response_ ### Crash Report https://mclo.gs/7lTdvDW [comment by mezz-bot (collaborator)] 🚀 A fix for this issue is available in Just Enough Items version `19.43.0.393` for Minecraft `1.21.1`.
